# food_clamshell — realism QA repair

Thin ribbed PET walls, top retail label and front nutrition sticker; textured bulk food proxy, unresolved piece count.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f2164, f1842, f1855. Mean silhouette IoU 0.8330. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/food_clamshell_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/food_clamshell/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=B, proportions=B, colour_texture=C, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Added rectified original front nutrition sticker, previously missing.
- Refined size and registration; PET transmission and IOR corrected.
- Retained separate thin-walled body and lid and cavity-preserving contacts.
- Added a separate textured bulk food proxy from source imagery; no exact individual nut count inferred.

## Remaining

- Food is represented as one textured bulk proxy; true piece count and individual nut dynamics are unresolved.
- Lid attachment mechanism remains unresolved; model uses detachable lid.
- Fine sticker text is limited by source resolution.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.

- Re-measured source depth with ktools in all three review frames; retained depth/calibration uncertainty.
- Replaced unexplained mass priors with explicit constituent volume × density or textile-area budgets; synchronized part masses and COM metadata.
- Added portable MJCF rigid contacts and checked all convex collision meshes.
- Reduced PET wall/contact gauge toward thin retail packaging.
- Replaced the single opaque food block with individual irregular food visuals and local contacts.
- Preserved rectified original top/front stickers; recalculated PET and food masses.

Remaining:

- Lid attachment remains unobserved: detachable lid is a candidate, not a verified hinge.
- Food piece count/shape are representative; contents share a rigid assembly in the fallback.
- Mass, friction, restitution and stiffness remain estimates, not measured physical calibration.
